context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 features (required validation, client name, trader filters, treasury filters, settlement proof upload, deal detail view) have been fully tested. Backend has 30 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_fx_deals_features.py. Settlement proof upload uses Emergent object storage integration (not mocked). The app is fully functional with proper role-based access control.

feature_1_required_validation.details: Submit empty form shows validation errors for all required fields including client_name. Toast error 'Please fill in all required fields' shown. Backend returns 422 for missing fields.

feature_2_client_name.details: Client Name field visible on New Deal form, marked as required. Shown in My Deals table, Deal detail dialog, Treasury queue, and Review dialog. Saved correctly to database.

feature_3_trader_filters.details: Filters panel toggle works. Status dropdown (All/Pending/Confirmed/Returned), client text search, currency filter, date from/to, clear filters button all working. 'Active' badge shown when filters applied.

feature_4_treasury_filters.details: Treasury Deal Queue has client search, currency, date from/to filters. Clear filters button works. Active badge shown when filters applied.

feature_5_settlement_proof.details: Upload proof button in deal detail dialog. API accepts image files (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF), rejects non-image files with 400 error. Images stored in Emergent object storage. Delete proof works.

feature_6_deal_detail.details: Click view button opens deal detail dialog with all fields: client, transaction/transfer type, dates, currencies, amounts, rate, from/to company/bank/account, status, created by, processed info, remarks, treasury remarks, settlement proofs section.
